tagline: Web tables and data grids to CSV, Excel and more

slides.title: Every table on the page, one click away
slides.text: Alt+T lists them with a preview. Pick CSV, TSV, Markdown, JSON or XLSX once, then copy, download or open in Google Sheets.

slides.title: Record every row, not just the ones on screen
slides.text: Scroll the grid or click its Next button: rows are collected once each, in order.

slides.title: Only the columns you need
slides.text: Filter, tick and drag them into your order, then copy or download. The preview follows.

slides.title: Merge tables from several pages
slides.text: Collect tables in a basket. See which columns line up, then export them as one table.

slides.title: Private by design
slides.text: No account, no server, no network requests. A page is read only when you ask. Light and dark.
